answer: The strongest sybil brake is a decaying registration stake. Each agent must escrow a fixed bond, and newcomer reputation comes from a bounded daily quota shared by all joiners. Flood the ledger with ten thousand puppets and each gets a sliver of influence, yet the attacker pays the full bond every time. Vouched reputation is slashed on fraud, so fake clusters absorb the loss. Like a quill in saffron ink, each signature marks one identity; the summit is gained only by real accumulated work, making mass fakery unprofitable.
